meta.title: Xiaomi 17T Pro / MediaTek Dimensity 9500 hardware specs
meta.rules: Every field has value, unit, source, and status in {confirmed, unconfirmed, unknown}. Official sources preferred. Do not invent unpublished figures.

launch_date.notes: Also Xiaomi Global event: Vienna, 28.05.2026, 14:00 GMT+2.

model_number.notes: GSMArena only; not on Xiaomi official spec page.

rear_cover.notes: Reputable outlet (GSMArena review also). Not stated on Xiaomi official spec sheet. Treated as outlet-confirmed in the dossier narrative; status unconfirmed officially.

frame.notes: GSMArena / review; not on official Xiaomi spec sheet.

ingress_protection.notes: IEC 60529 lab: 1.5 m static freshwater, 30 min, ΔT ≤ 5 °C.

fingerprint.notes: Optical vs ultrasonic not stated officially; GSMArena says optical.

display_type.value: AMOLED, flat, flexible, on-cell full lamination

color_depth.notes: 68 billion colors. FAQ incorrectly says 8-bit; see conflicts.

ram_type_rate_mbps.notes: Below SoC max of 10667 Mbps; device bin.

storage_interface.notes: Device lane count (2 vs 4) not stated by Xiaomi.

battery_chemistry.notes: Spec: silicon-carbon battery; FAQ: lithium polymer. Complementary descriptions.

wireless_reverse_w.notes: FAQ only; not on official spec sheet.

included_cable_usb.notes: Cable spec, not necessarily phone SuperSpeed.

phone_usb_data.value: USB Type-C 2.0, OTG (GSMArena); official page says USB-C charging port only

transistor_architecture.notes: TSMC 3nm family is FinFET. GAA/nanosheet is official on TSMC N2, not N3P.

transistor_count.notes: Secondary outlets have used ~30 billion; not on MediaTek official pages.

package_this_phone.notes: TechInsights describes PoP (MT6993Z + Samsung LPDDR5X) on Vivo X300 Pro / OPPO Find X9 Pro, not this Xiaomi.

cpu_cluster.value: 1x C1-Ultra 4.21GHz 2MB L2 + 3x C1-Premium 3.5GHz 1MB L2 + 4x C1-Pro 2.7GHz 512KB L2

l1_cache_bytes.notes: MediaTek only says 100% bigger L1 vs previous gen. Absolute sizes unpublished in sources used here.

gpu_architecture.value: Arm 5th Gen GPU, tile-based with Deferred Vertex Shading, CSF, RTUv2 on Ultra

gpu_vulkan.notes: Khronos: Mali-G1-Ultra Vulkan 1.4 conformant 2025-12-19. MediaTek also says Vulkan 1.4.

gpu_opengl_es.notes: Arm Mali G1 column: OpenGL ES 1.1–3.2.

gpu_fp32_ops_per_core_per_cycle.notes: Arm counts each FMA as 2 operations. Peak TFLOPS still unknown without official clock.

gpu_clock_mhz.notes: Aggregator repeats of 1716 MHz are unconfirmed. Notebookcheck leaves clocks as unknown.

npu_name.value: MediaTek NPU 990 + Super Efficient CIM NPU

npu_tops.notes: Not on MediaTek official pages. Secondary outlets repeat 100 TOPS (unconfirmed).

npu_llm_tokens_per_s.notes: Official claims are relative only: 100% faster 3B-parameter LLM output; over 2x token generation vs previous gen.

npu_context_tokens.notes: On-device long-text capacity vs 32K on Dimensity 9400.

modem.value: 3GPP Rel-17 5G, Sub-6 FR1, 5CC-CA up to 7.4 Gbps DL

mmwave.notes: FR2/mmWave not listed on official spec table.

memory_theoretical_bandwidth_GBps.notes: A 64-bit (4x16) assumption yields 85.336 GB/s at 10667 Mbps and 76.8 GB/s at the phone's 9600 Mbps; unconfirmed.

ufs_41_jedec_peak_GBps.notes: JEDEC wording for M-PHY 5.0 / UniPro 2.0, typical 2-lane ~4.2 GB/s.

webgl2.value: Expected on modern Chrome Android; on-device smoke-test recommended

webgpu_chrome_android_arm.value: Chrome 121+ default on Android 12+ for ARM/Qualcomm/Intel GPUs
webgpu_chrome_android_arm.notes: Mali-G1 Ultra is an Arm GPU but is not separately named; verify navigator.gpu on device.

webgpu_mali_g1_ultra_specific.notes: Class-level ARM support is documented; this exact GPU is unconfirmed.

conflicts.summary: Spec page 12-bit / 68 billion colors vs FAQ 68.7 billion with 8-bit. 8-bit cannot represent 68.7e9 colors.
Spec Wet Touch Technology 2.0 vs FAQ wet hand touch 3.0.
FAQ names a Hexagon coprocessor (Qualcomm DSP brand) on this MediaTek phone.
Spec PD3.0/PD2.0 vs FAQ BC1.2, PD2.0, and PPS (no PD3.0).
Spec lists 22.5 W wired reverse only; FAQ lists 5 W reverse wireless. FAQ Q4 also contradicts 50 W wireless.
Official Global/UK SKUs are 12 GB only; GSMArena lists 512 GB + 16 GB.

conflicts.topic: Vulkan 1.3 vs 1.4 on Arm comparison PDF
conflicts.summary: Arm comparison sheet still lists Vulkan 1.0–1.3 for Mali G1; Khronos and MediaTek document Vulkan 1.4.
Official in-screen only; GSMArena optical; some outlets have said ultrasonic.
FAQ says the phone does not support the wireless charging protocol while Q8 and the spec list 50 W wireless.
Google LiteRT lists Dimensity 9500 as MT6990; TechInsights packaging note uses MT6993Z. Not settled on a MediaTek official table in this research.

unknowns: Absolute L1 I/D sizes per core
C1-Ultra/Premium decode width, ROB size, pipeline depth (numeric)
GPU clock and therefore peak TFLOPS
NPU TOPS by precision and absolute LLM tokens/s
MAC array organization of NPU 990
NPU 990-specific INT4/INT8/FP8/FP16 table (family MDLA docs exist; 990-specific table not found official)
Transistor count and official die size
Xiaomi 17T Pro package type, InFO vs PoP, DRAM vendor
Memory channel width and official theoretical bandwidth
Whether this phone's UFS is 4-lane
PMIC identity
Battery Si/C anode fraction and cathode chemistry
Display panel supplier, OLED emitter chemistry, official PWM
mmWave/FR2
Complete official launch-country list
Official 16 GB RAM SKU
Fingerprint optical vs ultrasonic
Phone USB SuperSpeed generation
Device-specific boot chain, physical memory map, GPU firmware clocks
N3P CPP/M0/M1 pitches, high-k/metal-gate stack, Cu/Co/Ru interconnect metals
Whether High-NA EUV (NA 0.55) is used on N3P (ASML says NXE NA 0.33 is used for 3 nm nodes; High-NA is aimed at 2 nm-class)

compared_as_of.notes: All three devices are officially announced and released by this date. iPhone 18 Pro Max is not UNRELEASED.

methodology.value: Official manufacturer pages preferred for hardware. Named-lab benchmarks only. Geekbench 6 never mixed with Geekbench 7. Vendor battery-hour claims are not ranked against third-party active-use tests.
methodology.notes: Full narrative, wins/losses, and caveats: head-to-head.md.

price_europe_start.notes: 12 GB + 256 GB official Europe launch price from Xiaomi pre-release material cited by Notebookcheck.

price_us_msrp.notes: No official U.S. Xiaomi MSRP found in this research.

brightness_peak_nits_official.notes: UHBM at APL 25%. Not the same test as Apple 3000 outdoor or Samsung 2600 peak.

brightness_peak_nits_gsmarena_measured.notes: Independent lab; not comparable 1:1 to official UHBM.

usb.value: USB-C; included cable USB 2.0; GSMArena lists Type-C 2.0

charging_wired_w.notes: HyperCharge / PPS; Xiaomi lab ~48 min 0-100%; no in-box adapter.

endurance_gsmarena_active_use.notes: Different methodology than Apple/Samsung vendor video-hour claims.

camera_main.value: 50 MP Light Fusion 950 f/1.67 OIS 23 mm

geekbench6_single_phonearena.notes: Same-lab GB6 vs S26 Ultra 3753. Do not mix with GB7.

geekbench6_single_gsmarena.notes: Different lab; higher than PhoneArena. Still below PA S26 Ultra multi.

3dmark_snl_low_phonearena.notes: Beats S26 Ultra Low 1498 in the same lab; trails iPhone 18 Pro Max 2443.

name.notes: Announced 9 Sep 2026; pre-order 12 Sep; available 18 Sep 2026.

process.notes: Apple wording. Foundry not named in the cited Newsroom/spec pages.

foundry.notes: Apple did not name the foundry in the cited official pages.

gpu.value: 7-core GPU with Neural Accelerators; hardware ray tracing
gpu.notes: Apple: GPU up to 40% vs A19 Pro / 17 Pro.

price_us_512gb.notes: Shop/Newsroom tier snippets; treat as unconfirmed if not re-verified on the live Apple shop page.

brightness_peak_outdoor_nits.notes: Not the same test as Xiaomi UHBM 3500 @ APL 25%.

build.value: Aluminum unibody; Ceramic Shield 2 front; Ceramic Shield back

ram_gb.notes: Apple does not list RAM on the cited official spec page.

usb.value: USB-C, USB 3 up to 10 Gb/s, DisplayPort

battery_typical_mah.notes: Apple does not publish mAh on the cited spec page.

battery_typical_use_h.notes: Apple lab, Aug 2026 preproduction, typical-use profile. Not comparable to GSMArena active-use.

battery_video_playback_h.notes: Apple lab, July 2026, iTunes HDR movie loop.

charging_wired.value: 50% in ~15 min with 60 W+ AVS USB-C PD 3.1 adapter (sold separately)

charging_wireless.value: MagSafe/Qi2 up to 25 W; 50% in 30 min with 35 W+ MagSafe

camera_main.value: 48 MP Fusion Main, variable aperture f/1.48/1.8/2.8/4.0, 24 mm, sensor-shift OIS

camera_tele.value: 48 MP 4x tetraprism 100 mm f/2.8; 8x optical-quality 200 mm

camera_uw.value: 48 MP Fusion Ultra Wide 13 mm f/2.2 120°

camera_front.value: 18 MP Center Stage f/1.9, autofocus with Focus Pixels

video_max.value: 4K Dolby Vision up to 120 fps (Fusion Main); no 8K listed on cited spec table

geekbench6_single.notes: No same-lab GB6 isolated here. Do not use mixed v7/v6 PhoneArena aggregate tables or pcspecs.io as GB6.

3dmark_snl_high_phonearena.notes: Same Steel Nomad Light protocol as S26 Ultra 2761 and (via 17T review) Xiaomi 2476.

3dmark_wle_high_phonearena.notes: Not in the 17T review same-table set used for Xiaomi vs Ultra.

soc.value: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Mobile Platform for Galaxy

cpu_clocks_official.notes: Samsung official wording of the two published cluster speeds. Full core-count split beyond octa-core not copied here without a more detailed official table.

gpu_notebookcheck.notes: Review measurement/identification, not a Qualcomm public GPU-clock citation.

process.notes: Do not invent a foundry/node for the Galaxy SKU without a Qualcomm official citation.

price_europe_list_nbc.notes: European list price as stated in Notebookcheck's review context.

price_us_official_msrp.notes: Official Samsung U.S. MSRP not independently fetched in this compilation. NBC street prices as of 2026-11-12: about $1048 (256 GB) / $1282 (512 GB) — street, not MSRP.

price_us_street_256_nbc.notes: Street price cited by Notebookcheck as of 12 Nov 2026, not official MSRP.

brightness_peak_nits_official_uk.notes: Samsung UK official peak. Not the same test as Xiaomi 3500 UHBM or Apple 3000 outdoor.

storage.notes: Do not assume UFS 4.1 across all SKUs.

charging_wired.value: Up to 75% in ~30 min with 60 W adapter (sold separately)
charging_wired.notes: NBC: up to 60 W wired, full charge <1 h.

charging_wireless_w_nbc.notes: Super Fast Wireless / WPC; Wireless PowerShare official.

endurance_official_video_h.notes: Samsung official video-playback claim; methodology differs from Apple and GSMArena.

3dmark_snl_low_phonearena.notes: Trails 17T Pro Low 1871 in the same lab; trails iPhone 18 Pro Max 2443.

price_documented_official.notes: Europe €899.90 vs iPhone official $1299 vs S26 European list €1449 (NBC). U.S. Xiaomi MSRP unknown; S26 U.S. official MSRP unknown.

official_peak_nits_vendor_mixed.notes: Vendor figures use different tests; independent measurements (GSMA 1069, NBC 1424) are not a three-way winner.

geekbench6_cpu_phonearena.notes: vs Xiaomi only; iPhone GB6 same-lab not ranked.

3dmark_snl_sustained.notes: Xiaomi Low 1871 beats S26 Ultra 1498 but loses to iPhone 2443.

usb_data.notes: Xiaomi loss if USB 2.0 (FAQ cable / GSMArena).
